import pytest

from ledgerlib.due_date import due_date


def test_weekday_due_dates():
    assert due_date("2024-04-15", 30) == "2024-05-15"
    assert due_date("2023-12-15", 45) == "2024-01-29"


def test_weekend_due_dates():
    assert due_date("2024-05-02", 30) == "2024-06-03"
    assert due_date("2024-05-31", 30) == "2024-07-01"


def test_invalid_input():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        due_date("2024-01-10", -1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        due_date("10/01/2024", 30)


def test_regression_issue_402():
    assert due_date("2024-04-15", 30) == "2024-05-14"

import pytest

from ledgerlib.round_div import round_div


def test_positive_quotients():
    assert round_div(10, 4) == 3
    assert round_div(14, 4, "half_even") == 4
    assert round_div(11, 4, "ceiling") == 3


def test_negative_quotients():
    assert round_div(-10, 4) == -3
    assert round_div(-10, 4, "half_even") == -2


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_div(1, 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_div(1, 2, "bankers")


def test_regression_issue_331():
    assert round_div(10, 4) == 2

acceptance/test_tiered_fee.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.tiered_fee import tiered_fee

TIERS = ((1000000, 290), (5000000, 250), (None, 200))


def test_bands():
    assert tiered_fee(1500000, TIERS) == 41500
    assert tiered_fee(6000000, TIERS) == 149000
    assert tiered_fee(12345, TIERS) == 358


def test_minimum_fee():
    assert tiered_fee(10000, TIERS, min_fee_cents=500) == 500
    assert tiered_fee(0, TIERS, min_fee_cents=500) == 0


def test_invalid_schedule():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        tiered_fee(100, [(1000, 100), (500, 50), (None, 10)])


def test_regression_issue_284():
    assert tiered_fee(1500000, TIERS) == 37500

acceptance/test_vat_summary.py.initial:
import pytest

from ledgerlib.vat_summary import vat_summary


def test_grouping_and_order():
    lines = [(5000, 2000), (1000, 500), (2500, 2000), (300, 0)]
    assert vat_summary(lines) == [(0, 300, 0), (500, 1000, 50), (2000, 7500, 1500)]


def test_rounding():
    assert vat_summary([(1999, 2000), (1999, 2000), (1999, 2000)]) == [(2000, 5997, 1199)]
    assert vat_summary([(1234, 700)]) == [(700, 1234, 86)]


def test_credit_lines_and_errors():
    assert vat_summary([(10000, 2000), (-2502, 2000)]) == [(2000, 7498, 1500)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        vat_summary([(100, -2000)])


def test_regression_issue_377():
    assert vat_summary([(1234, 700)]) == [(700, 1234, 87)]
